title: Air pollution and consumers’ avoidance behavior: Evidence from high-frequency payment data in China
title_zh: 空气污染与消费者规避行为：来自中国高频支付数据的证据

abstract: This study reassesses Peru’s inflation dynamics during the Pacific War by incorporating alternative exchange rate methodologies that account for the widespread use of paper currency (sol en billete) in domestic transactions. Using archival sources from Lima’s principal newspapers and government documents, combined with price series from Seminario (2016) and Boloña (1993), this analysis reveals that conventional silver-based exchange rate assumptions systematically underestimated wartime inflation. The recalibrated methodology shows inflation peaking at nearly 180 percent during the war’s most intense phase, contrasting dramatically with previous silver-based estimates suggesting price stability. Contemporary currency spread evidence demonstrates the sol en billete depreciating over 1000 percent relative to silver currency between 1879–1880, validating the magnitude of monetary instability captured in our reconstruction. These findings position the Pacific War as one of Peru’s most severe inflationary episodes, averaging over 30 percent annually during the conflict period, rather than the mild deflation suggested by conventional approaches. This historical perspective reveals Peru’s modern era (1997–2025) as its longest period of monetary stability in over three centuries. The corrected estimates align with broader patterns of wartime monetary instability across Latin America while demonstrating how exchange rate methodology choices fundamentally alter historical narratives. This framework offers broader applicability for reassessing historical inflation in dual-currency environments during institutional transitions.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过纳入替代性汇率方法，重新评估了太平洋战争期间秘鲁的通胀动态，这些方法考虑了纸币（索尔纸币）在国内交易中的广泛使用。利用利马主要报纸和政府文件的档案资料，并结合Seminario（2016）和Boloña（1993）的价格序列，本分析揭示，基于白银的传统汇率假设系统性地低估了战时通胀。重新校准的方法显示，在战争最激烈阶段，通胀率峰值接近180%，与先前基于白银的估计所暗示的价格稳定形成鲜明对比。当代货币价差证据表明，1879年至1880年间，索尔纸币相对于白银货币贬值超过1000%，验证了本重建所捕捉的货币不稳定程度的规模。这些发现将太平洋战争定位为秘鲁最严重的通胀事件之一，战争期间年均通胀率超过30%，而非传统方法所暗示的温和通缩。这一历史视角揭示，秘鲁现代时期（1997—2025年）是其三个多世纪以来最长的货币稳定期。修正后的估计与拉丁美洲战时货币不稳定的更广泛模式相一致，同时展示了汇率方法选择如何从根本上改变历史叙事。该框架为在制度转型期间重新评估双货币环境中的历史通胀提供了更广泛的适用性。
title: The price of war: Recalculating inflation in Peru during the Pacific War era
title_zh: 战争的成本：重新计算太平洋战争时期秘鲁的通货膨胀

abstract: When natives realize that their country’s welfare system includes immigrants, they may prefer high-income immigrants to low-income ones because the former will contribute more to the system because of its redistributive nature. We examine this causal effect using a novel survey experiment. In the experiment, we randomly assign half of the respondents to receive information designed to increase their perception that the national healthcare insurance system includes immigrants. Subsequently, we assess respondents’ preferences for different types of immigrants through a conjoint experiment. Our findings reveal that the treatment reduced preferences for low-income immigrants but increased preferences for high-income immigrants. Furthermore, these effects were observed only among those who did not perceive an increase in foreign workers as a threat to their job security. Thus, concerns about the welfare system and job insecurity should not be considered in isolation. Overall, the results indicate that institutional design (particularly the redistributive structure of welfare systems) shapes political preferences regarding immigration policy.
abstract_zh: 当本地居民意识到本国的福利体系涵盖移民时，他们可能更倾向于高收入移民而非低收入移民，因为前者由于福利体系的再分配性质，将为该体系贡献更多。我们通过一项新颖的问卷调查实验来考察这一因果效应。在实验中，我们随机分配一半的受访者接收旨在增强其认知——即国家医疗保险体系包含移民——的信息。随后，我们通过一个联合实验评估受访者对不同类型移民的偏好。研究结果显示，该处理降低了对低收入移民的偏好，但增加了对高收入移民的偏好。此外，这些效应仅出现在那些不认为外籍工人增加对其工作安全构成威胁的受访者中。因此，对福利体系的担忧与工作不安全感不应被孤立考虑。总体而言，结果表明制度设计（尤其是福利体系的再分配结构）塑造了关于移民政策的政治偏好。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Welfare state and natives’ preferences for immigrants’ types
title_zh: 福利国家与本地居民对移民类型的偏好

abstract: We test Le Play's (1875) hypothesis that the French Revolution contributed to France's early fertility decline by imposing equal partition of inheritance among all children, including women. We combine new data on local inheritance rules before the Revolution and individual-level demographic data from historical sources and crowdsourced genealogies. Difference-in-differences and regression-discontinuity estimates show that the inheritance reforms enacted during the Revolution reduced completed fertility by 0.5 children. A key mechanism was the desire to avoid land fragmentation across generations. These reforms closed the fertility gap between regions with different historical inheritance rules and crucially contributed to France's demographic transition.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了勒普莱（1875年）的假说，即法国大革命通过强制实行所有子女（包括女性）平等继承遗产的规定，促进了法国早期生育率的下降。我们将大革命前地方继承规则的新数据与来自历史资料和众包家谱的个人层面人口统计数据相结合。双重差分法和断点回归估计显示，大革命期间实施的继承改革使完成生育率降低了0.5个孩子。一个关键机制是避免土地在代际间分割的愿望。这些改革缩小了历史上不同继承规则地区之间的生育率差距，并对法国的 demographic transition 起到了关键作用。
title: Revolutionary Transition: Inheritance Change and Fertility Decline
title_zh: 革命性转型：继承制度变迁与生育率下降

abstract: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含健康冲击、健康保险及医疗治疗决策的劳动供给与人力资本形成的生命周期模型。利用该模型，我们研究了健康冲击对健康、劳动供给、收入及收入不平等的影响。同时，我们模拟了向缺乏雇主提供保险的个体提供公共保险的情形。尽管这显著增加了医疗支出，但它为低技能工人创造了积极的劳动供给激励，同时降低了社会保险、医疗补助及免费医疗的成本。净项目成本适中，且在平衡预算模拟中，所有模型个体的事前福利均有所改善。
title: Health Shocks, Health Insurance, Human Capital, and the Dynamics of Earnings and Health
title_zh: 健康冲击、医疗保险、人力资本与收入及健康的动态关系

abstract: This paper examines the nature of entrepreneurship using a novel panel dataset based on US Internal Revenue Service data. We analyze income growth trajectories and the determinants of entrepreneurial choice for business owners. Compared with prior household survey–based studies, we find that self-employed individuals have significantly higher average incomes and steeper income growth than their wage-earning matched peers. Contrary to survey evidence, we find a limited role for nonpecuniary motives, uninsurable risk, and liquidity constraints driving entrepreneurial choice. Prior work experience predicts entrepreneurial entry. Entry and exit rates into self-employment remain stable over time, including during the Great Recession.
abstract_zh: 本文利用基于美国国税局数据的新颖面板数据集，探讨了创业的本质。我们分析了企业主的收入增长轨迹及创业选择的决定因素。与以往基于家庭调查的研究相比，我们发现自雇人士的平均收入显著更高，且收入增长曲线比与之匹配的工薪阶层更为陡峭。与调查证据相反，我们发现非金钱动机、不可保险风险及流动性约束在驱动创业选择方面的作用有限。先前的工作经验预示着创业进入。自雇的进入率和退出率随时间保持稳定，包括在大衰退期间也是如此。
title: On the Nature of Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 论创业的本质

abstract: The goal of this paper is to link attitude toward risk over personal consumption with attitude toward risk over social consumptions. Because many everyday choices involve risk, these attitudes enter virtually every realm of individual decision-making. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for deducing preferences over risky social choices (which have consequences both for the Decision Maker and for others) from risky personal choices (which have consequences only for the Decision Maker) and riskless social choices, and we offer an experimental test of the theory. The experiments generate a rich dataset that enables completely non-parametric revealed preference tests of the theory at the level of the individual subject. Many subjects behave as predicted by the theory but a substantial fraction do not. JEL Classification Numbers: C91, D63, D81.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在将个人消费风险态度与社会消费风险态度联系起来。由于众多日常选择涉及风险，这些态度几乎渗透到个体决策的各个领域。我们提供了必要且充分的条件，用以从个人风险选择（仅对决策者自身产生影响）及无风险社会选择中，推导出对风险性社会选择（对决策者及他人均产生影响）的偏好，并对该理论进行了实验检验。实验产生了丰富的数据集，使得能够在个体受试者层面进行完全非参数化的显示性偏好检验。许多受试者的行为符合理论预测，但相当一部分并非如此。JEL分类号：C91, D63, D81。
title: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
title_zh: 连接社会偏好与个人偏好：理论与实验

abstract: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
abstract_zh: 玻璃墙：女性获取高价值技能机会所面临约束的实验证据
title: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
title_zh: 玻璃墙：女性获取高价值技能机会所面临限制的实验证据

abstract: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.
abstract_zh: 阿莱斯对期望效用理论（EUT）的批评促使了风险条件下选择理论的发展，这些理论放宽了独立性公理，但坚持排序（完备性和传递性）及单调性（相对于一阶随机占优）的基本/传统公理。与旨在检验独立性的实验研究不同，我们的实验更为全面，测试了EUT所依据的整套公理。我们的计量分析也是非参数的，并在每个个体受试者层面进行。对于绝大多数受试者而言，偏离独立性的程度相对于偏离排序和/或单调性的程度较小。
title: Ever since Allais
title_zh: 自阿莱以来

abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. (JEL C93, D72, Z13)
abstract_zh: 我们通过法国顶尖社会科学与政治学府——巴黎政治学院的一项自然实验，考察社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点。学生在学术课程开始前被准随机分配至短期融合小组，这一机制缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊形成。以同组归属作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现友谊使观点差异缩小了平均差距的44%。研究证据支持一种同质性强化机制：友谊最初在政治立场相近的学生间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化其观点相似性。（JEL C93, D72, Z13）
title: Friendship Networks and Political Opinions
title_zh: 友谊网络与政治观点

abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)
abstract_zh: 基于项目级交易数据编制的居民消费价格指数，能够反映质量变化与消费者替代行为。由于均衡状态下新旧产品价格相互关联，交易数据需应对项目快速更替的挑战。本文评估了多种大规模质量变化测算方法，研究表明：采用计量经济学或机器学习进行特征价格估计，并结合需同步观测项目级价格与支出的指数公式，所构建的特征价格超优指数能更精准地衡量生活成本。相较于传统官方统计方法，将普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代行为纳入考量后，通胀测算结果显著降低。（JEL分类号：C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）
title: Quality Adjustment at Scale: Hedonic versus Exact Demand-Based Price Indices
title_zh: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数的比较

abstract: Conflict along transportation routes during Somalia’s al-Shabaab insurgency significantly increases maize prices at distant locations, decreasing food security, health, and education. Estimated conflict risk has strong price effects independently of realized conflict, highlighting the importance of safety concerns. A model of least-cost route choice in the presence of conflict reveals that more and shorter alternative routes to circumvent conflict can lower prices but their effectiveness diminishes as violence becomes more correlated across routes. Alternatively, securing key transportation routes would alleviate price increases. A market access approach suggests spatial spillovers of conflict also matter for prices of more general baskets of food and nonfood items. (JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41)
abstract_zh: 索马里青年党叛乱期间，运输路线上的冲突显著抬高了偏远地区的玉米价格，进而削弱了粮食安全、健康与教育水平。冲突风险的估计值独立于已发生的冲突本身，对价格产生强烈影响，凸显了安全关切的重要性。基于冲突环境下最低成本路线选择模型的分析表明：增加更多且更短的替代路线以规避冲突可降低价格，但随着暴力事件在路线间的相关性增强，其效果逐渐减弱。另一种方案是保障关键运输路线的安全，这将有效缓解价格上涨。市场准入分析进一步揭示，冲突的空间溢出效应同样影响更广泛的食品与非食品类商品价格。（JEL分类号：D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41）
title: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
title_zh: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应

abstract: This paper develops an asset market-based test for preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. Our main theorem provides a characterization of preference for early resolution of uncertainty in terms of the risk premium realized during the period when the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements is resolved. Empirically, we find support for preference for early resolution of uncertainty based on evidence on the dynamics of the implied volatility of S&P 500 index options before Federal Open Market Committee announcements. (JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于资产市场的检验方法，用于评估不确定性解决时机偏好。核心定理表明，偏好不确定性尽早解决的特征可通过宏观经济公告信息释放期间所实现的风险溢价来刻画。基于联邦公开市场委员会公告发布前后标普500指数期权隐含波动率的动态证据，实证结果支持市场参与者存在偏好不确定性尽早解决的倾向。（JEL分类号：D81, D83, G13, G14, G41）
title: Identifying Preference for Early Resolution from Asset Prices
title_zh: 从资产价格中识别对早期解决的偏好

abstract: We present a simple model showing how income inequality and the income elasticity of demand jointly shape the tax progressivity of indirect taxes, with rising inequality increasing the regressivity of taxes on necessities. We test the model’s predictions by analyzing the Swedish carbon tax on transport fuel. We find that the tax becomes increasingly regressive over time, closely tracking rising income inequality. We also show that the relative incidence shifts from regressive to progressive when using annual expenditure rather than annual income as the welfare measure, as expenditure is more evenly distributed. A cross-country analysis of gasoline taxes in high-income nations further supports our findings, establishing a strong correlation between higher inequality and greater regressivity. Our model helps policymakers identify when complementary redistributive measures such as lump-sum transfers may become necessary.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约模型，揭示收入不平等与需求收入弹性如何共同塑造间接税的累进性：不平等加剧会提高必需品税的累退性。通过分析瑞典交通燃料碳税，我们验证了模型预测：该税种的累退性随时间推移持续增强，与收入不平等加剧趋势高度吻合。研究还表明，当采用年度支出（而非年度收入）作为福利衡量指标时，相对税负分布从累退转为累进——因为支出分布更为均衡。对高收入国家汽油税的跨国分析进一步支持了我们的发现：不平等程度越高，累退性越强。该模型有助于政策制定者识别何时需要配套实施一次性转移支付等再分配措施。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
title_zh: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用

abstract: This paper measures the value of information mortgage brokers provide to UK households using an application of a structural model of search. Aided by administrative loans data, we document the existence of a substantial degree of unexplained price dispersion, and observe that while mortgages obtained from brokers are cheaper, borrowers who use intermediaries pay more once commissions are factored in. However, our results also show that broker presence exerts negative pressure on lenders’ market power. Compared to a world where broker advice is unavailable, brokers reduce average monthly mortgage costs by 21% and eliminate a part of welfare losses arising from costly search. In other words, eliminating brokers from the market would lead to even higher borrowing costs from the group of borrowers who need it most: those with the highest search costs. We also find that regulation in support of market centralization halves lenders’ markups and lowers monthly costs of an average mortgage by 4.4%.
abstract_zh: 本文通过应用搜索的结构模型，衡量了抵押贷款经纪人为英国家庭提供的信息价值。借助行政贷款数据，我们记录了存在显著程度的未解释价格离散现象，并观察到虽然通过经纪人获得的抵押贷款更便宜，但使用中介的借款人在计入佣金后支付更多。然而，我们的结果也表明，经纪人的存在对贷款人的市场势力施加了负面压力。与没有经纪人建议的世界相比，经纪人将平均月度抵押贷款成本降低了21%，并消除了因昂贵搜索而产生的部分福利损失。换言之，将经纪人从市场中剔除将导致最需要帮助的借款人群体——即搜索成本最高者——面临更高的借款成本。我们还发现，支持市场集中化的监管措施使贷款人的加价减半，并将平均抵押贷款的月度成本降低了4.4%。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Estimating the value of information in the UK mortgage market
title_zh: 英国抵押贷款市场信息价值评估

abstract: We study how corporate debt influences the competitive outcomes of horizontal and conglomerate mergers. In contrast to standard models where debt does not affect pricing, our framework shows that mergers can spread fixed debt obligations across a broader product portfolio, creating an “insurance effect” against adverse demand shocks. This effect interacts with the traditional recapture effect from reduced competition. Using numerical simulations and a case study of a major casino merger, we find that debt can either dampen or amplify post-merger price increases, depending on the merger’s structure and the market environment.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了企业债务如何影响横向并购与混合并购的竞争结果。与债务不影响定价的标准模型不同，我们的框架表明，并购能将固定债务负担分散至更广泛的产品组合中，从而产生一种针对不利需求冲击的“保险效应”。这一效应与竞争减弱带来的传统“回收效应”相互作用。通过数值模拟及对一家大型赌场并购案例的研究，我们发现，债务可能抑制或放大并购后的价格上涨，具体取决于并购的结构及市场环境。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 107
title: Financial structure and mergers
title_zh: 金融结构与并购

abstract: We consider a class of cost allocation problems where a public facility is shared by a group of agents with “needs” for it, and these needs possess a “nested” character. A facility accommodating an agent can also accommodate any other agent with a lower need at no extra cost. The facility has to be provided to accommodate all agents. The question is how to allocate its cost among them. An example is airlines sharing an airstrip. These problems are therefore known as “airport problems”. We identify desirable rules through the axiomatic approach. We propose three main axioms: (i) order preservation in contribution rates, which requires the order of agents’ contribution rates to match the order of their needs; (ii) minimizing the range of contribution rates, which requires that the difference between the highest and lowest contribution rates among agents be minimized; and (iii) single-constraint consistency, which is an expression of the well-known “consistency” principle. Drawing inspiration from the literature on economic design, we adapt the proportionality principle to guarantee that no group of agents subsidizes the complementary group. We call this resulting rule the “constrained proportional rule”. Our main result is that this rule is the only rule satisfying these three axioms. We also provide new characterizations of two other well-known rules. The “constrained equal contributions rule” is the only rule minimizing the variance of contributions. The “constrained equal benefits rule” is the only rule minimizing the range (or variance) of benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一类成本分配问题，其中一项公共设施由一群对其有“需求”的代理人共享，且这些需求具有“嵌套”特征。容纳某一代理人的设施，也能以零额外成本容纳任何需求更低的代理人。该设施必须提供以容纳所有代理人。问题在于如何在代理人之间分配其成本。一个例子是航空公司共享一条跑道，因此这些问题被称为“机场问题”。我们通过公理化方法识别理想的规则。我们提出三个主要公理：（i）贡献率的顺序保持，要求代理人贡献率的顺序与其需求顺序一致；（ii）贡献率范围最小化，要求代理人中最高与最低贡献率之间的差异最小化；（iii）单约束一致性，这是著名的“一致性”原则的一种表达。借鉴经济设计文献中的思想，我们调整比例原则，以确保没有任何代理人群体补贴互补群体。我们将由此得到的规则称为“约束比例规则”。我们的主要结果是，该规则是唯一满足这三个公理的规则。我们还提供了另外两个著名规则的新特征化。“约束等贡献规则”是唯一使贡献方差最小化的规则。“约束等收益规则”是唯一使收益范围（或方差）最小化的规则。
title: Three rules for airport problems: Characterizations via order preservation, dispersion minimization, and consistency
title_zh: 机场问题的三条规则：基于顺序保持、分散最小化与一致性的刻画

abstract: Given a model of preferences, what choice data or experiment is sufficient to definitively test whether a subject is consistent with the model or to classify them into some “type” within the model? We characterize all experiments that test or classify a given model using a novel graph-theoretic construction: the labeled permutohedron. We show how these results can be used to identify the smallest experiments that achieve a particular goal.
abstract_zh: 给定偏好模型，何种选择数据或实验足以明确检验受试者是否与模型一致，或将其归类为模型内的某种“类型”？我们通过一种新颖的图论构造——标记置换多面体——刻画了所有检验或分类给定模型的实验。我们展示了这些结果如何用于识别实现特定目标的最小实验。
title: Which experiments test a model?
title_zh: 哪些实验检验了一个模型？

abstract: We compare preferences for temporal resolution when uncertainty is resolved over a probability rather than a value. In various theoretical frameworks, preferences over gradual versus one-shot resolution do not depend on whether values or probabilities define the main object of uncertainty. In our experiment, however, we find that preferences for resolution vary with the type of prize: subjects prefer gradual resolution for uncertain value prizes, whereas no such preference emerges for uncertain probability prizes. To explain our findings, we propose an explanation based on what we call “process utility”.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了当不确定性通过概率而非价值来消解时，人们对时间分辨率的偏好。在多种理论框架下，对于渐进式与一次性分辨的偏好并不取决于不确定性主要对象是由价值还是概率定义。然而，在我们的实验中，我们发现对分辨率的偏好随奖品类型而变化：对于不确定的价值奖品，受试者偏好渐进式分辨；而对于不确定的概率奖品，则未出现此类偏好。为解释我们的发现，我们提出了一种基于我们称之为“过程效用”的解释。
title: The resolution of uncertainty in the value and probability domains
title_zh: 价值与概率领域不确定性的消解

abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness of forward guidance when central banks face private agents with heterogeneous expectations allowing for a degree of bounded rationality. Exploiting unique survey-based measures of expected inflation, output growth, and interest rates, we estimate a small-scale New Keynesian model with forward guidance shocks for the United States and the other G7 countries plus Spain. We find that the share of fully-informed rational expectations (FIRE) agents in aggregate expectations is similar for the U.S., the U.K., Germany, and other major advanced economies (albeit far from one); however, Japan’s share is much lower. For each country, the estimate of the share of FIRE agents has declined over time as VAR-based expectations — the heuristic approach assumed under bounded rationality — became more prominent in explaining the more recent data. Forward guidance has correspondingly grown less effective. In a counterfactual analysis, we document that, in the wake of the global financial crisis, inflation would have been significantly higher and the zero lower bound on short-term interest rates much less of a constraint had the public fully incorporated central banks’ forward guidance statements as FIRE agents do. Moreover, in most cases, inflation would have declined more, and somewhat faster, in the wake of the post-COVID-19 inflation surge.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当中央银行面对具有异质性预期且允许一定程度的有限理性的私人主体时，前瞻指引的有效性。利用独特的基于调查的预期通胀、产出增长和利率度量，我们估计了一个包含前瞻指引冲击的小型新凯恩斯模型，覆盖美国及其他七国集团国家加上西班牙。我们发现，在总体预期中，完全信息理性预期（FIRE）主体的份额在美国、英国、德国及其他主要发达经济体中相似（尽管远未达到一）；然而，日本的份额则低得多。对于每个国家，FIRE主体份额的估计值随时间下降，因为基于VAR的预期——有限理性下假设的启发式方法——在解释近期数据时变得更加突出。相应地，前瞻指引的有效性减弱。在一项反事实分析中，我们记录到，在全球金融危机之后，如果公众像FIRE主体那样完全纳入中央银行的指引声明，通胀本会显著更高，短期利率的零下限约束也会小得多。此外，在大多数情况下，在COVID-19后通胀飙升之后，通胀本会下降更多，且速度稍快。
title: Living Up to Expectations: The Effectiveness of Forward Guidance and Inflation Dynamics Post-Global Financial Crisis
title_zh: 符合预期：全球金融危机后前瞻性指引的有效性与通胀动态

abstract: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. We combine this reform with the timing of union-bargained teacher retirements to isolate quasi-random variation in male quota teachers. Pupils exposed to male quota teachers transition more smoothly to postcompulsory education and have higher educational attainment and labor force attachment at age 25. Evidence suggests the quota improved the allocation of talent by mending imperfections in the unconstrained selection process. (JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45)
abstract_zh: 我们通过考察招生配额受益者在相关行业开始生产后的产出效应，评估了配额政策带来的公平与效率权衡。我们估算了废除小学男教师40%配额制度对学生长期发展的影响。通过将这项改革与工会协商的教师退休时间相结合，我们分离出配额制男教师的准随机变动。接触配额制男教师的学生在义务教育后阶段的过渡更为顺畅，且在25岁时拥有更高的教育成就和劳动力市场参与度。证据表明，该配额通过弥补无约束选拔过程中的缺陷，改善了人才配置效率。（JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45）
title: Quota versus Quality? Long-Term Gains from an Unusual Gender Quota
title_zh: 配额还是质量？一项特殊性别配额的长期收益

abstract: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)
abstract_zh: 精英大学是帮助有才华的学生跻身社会精英阶层，还是帮助现有精英维持其地位？我们结合智利的代际关联数据与断点回归设计发现，从代际视角来看，精英大学同时发挥了这两种作用。获得精英大学项目录取资格的低社会地位个体，其子女的社会环境发生了转变：子女更有可能进入高地位私立学校与大学，并与高地位同龄人居住相邻或建立友谊。相比之下，学业成绩并未受到影响。结合描述性与准实验研究结果的模拟分析表明，精英大学在降低代际社会流动性的同时，强化了社会资本与人力资本之间的关联。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13）
title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital
title_zh: 精英大学与人力资本和社会资本的代际传递

abstract: Policy choices often create trade-offs between workers and consumers. I examine how foreign competition alters the consumer welfare and domestic employment effects of mergers. I construct a model incorporating consumer demand, endogenous product portfolios, and employment decisions. Applying the model to Whirlpool’s acquisition of Maytag in the appliance industry, I compare the observed merger to a counterfactual acquisition by a foreign buyer. Although Whirlpool’s acquisition decreased consumer welfare by $271 million annually, it preserved 797 domestic jobs. These jobs must therefore be valued at more than $344, 000 per year for the domestic employment benefits to offset the consumer harm. (JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
abstract_zh: 政策选择往往在工人与消费者之间产生权衡。本文考察了外国竞争如何改变并购对消费者福利和国内就业的影响。我构建了一个包含消费者需求、内生产品组合和就业决策的模型。将该模型应用于家电行业惠而浦对美泰克的收购案例，我将实际发生的并购与外国买家收购的反事实情景进行了比较。尽管惠而浦的收购每年使消费者福利减少2.71亿美元，但保留了797个国内就业岗位。因此，要使国内就业收益抵消消费者损失，这些岗位的年价值必须超过34.4万美元。(JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
title: Mergers, Foreign Competition, and Jobs: Evidence from the US Appliance Industry
title_zh: 并购、外国竞争与就业：来自美国家电行业的证据

abstract: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用医疗补助计划中的一项自然实验，将近10万名参保者随机分配至公共运营的按服务收费体系与私人管理式医疗体系中。管理式医疗通过处方药的成本效益替代以及降低门诊服务价格，使成本降低了5.6%。我们提供的证据表明，药房利用管理是减少过度用药、鼓励替代为低成本药物且不降低可观测质量的关键机制。相比之下，医疗福利的私有化仅带来适度节约，且与医疗质量下降及消费者满意度降低相关。（JEL分类号：G22, H41, I13, I18, I38）
title: The Private Provision of Public Services: Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid
title_zh: 公共服务的私人提供：来自医疗补助随机分配的证据

title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角

abstract: Land multifunctionality requires integrated strategies to reconcile diverse human needs within finite resources. Conventional land sparing and sharing (LSS) frameworks, primarily applied to agricultural trade-offs between food production and biodiversity, inadequately address the non-agricultural production and living functions associated with construction land development. This study extends the LSS framework to holistically assess production, living, and ecological functions under construction land intensification. Focusing on China's karst region, we employed the Development Intensity Index (DII) as a quantitative strategy indicator. Using sub-basins in the Southwest China karst belt as analytical units over 2010–2019, we integrated land function measurements with the DII, nonparametric tests, Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing (LOWESS), and Bayesian Change Point (BCP) analysis to precisely delineate spatial strategy differentiation and nonlinear functional responses. Significant nonlinear relationships and critical threshold effects were revealed between land use strategies and functions. As DII increased, production function exhibited an inverted U-shaped trend, peaking at a DII of 6.2 then declining significantly. Living function maintained a continuous positive correlation, with its growth rate accelerating slightly beyond an intensity of 10.5. Ecology function remained negatively correlated, declining sharply at a DII of 0.65 followed by a slower decrease rate. The comprehensive land function index reaches an inflection point at a DII of 6.35, beyond which its growth rate diminishes until eventually turning negative. The research quantifies key functional response thresholds, broadens the LSS framework's applicability to multifunctional land systems encompassing construction land. This finding facilitates the scientific selection of land-use strategies and promotes the transition of territorial spatial development toward coordination and sustainability.
abstract_zh: 土地多功能性要求采取综合策略，在有限资源内协调多样化的人类需求。传统的土地节约与共享（LSS）框架主要应用于农业生产与生物多样性之间的权衡，未能充分涵盖与建设用地开发相关的非农业生产及生活功能。本研究将LSS框架拓展至建设用地集约化背景下生产、生活与生态功能的综合评估。以中国喀斯特地区为研究对象，采用发展强度指数（DII）作为定量化策略指标。以2010—2019年西南喀斯特带子流域为分析单元，将土地功能测度与DII、非参数检验、局部加权散点平滑（LOWESS）及贝叶斯变点（BCP）分析相结合，精确刻画空间策略分异及非线性功能响应。研究揭示了土地利用策略与功能之间显著的非线性关系及关键阈值效应。随着DII增加，生产功能呈倒U型趋势，在DII为6.2时达到峰值后显著下降；生活功能保持持续正相关，其增长率在强度超过10.5后略有加速；生态功能始终呈负相关，在DII为0.65时急剧下降，随后降速趋缓。综合土地功能指数在DII为6.35处达到拐点，此后其增长率逐渐减弱直至最终转为负值。本研究量化了关键功能响应阈值，拓展了LSS框架在涵盖建设用地的多功能土地系统中的适用性，有助于科学选择土地利用策略，推动国土空间开发向协调与可持续方向转型。

title: Land sparing and sharing: Understanding the relationship between different construction land strategies and land functions in karst areas
title_zh: 土地节约与共享：理解喀斯特地区不同建设用地策略与土地功能之间的关系

abstract: Forests play a crucial role in maintaining environmental balance by providing a wide range of valuable ecosystem services. Monitoring their change dynamics is increasingly important for planning, decision-making, and especially for evaluating conservation policies. Due to the significance of this issue, the number of studies examining global forests in terms of change trends is not uniform. The Hyrcanian forests, recognized as one of the most important temperate forests in the world and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site since 2019, serve as a notable example. The study of their change trends, particularly in light of recent conservation policies, has gained increasing importance. This study aims to analyze the spatial-temporal change trends of the Hyrcanian forests from 2000 to 2022 using remote sensing products. To assess the intensity and direction of changes, Sen’s slope and Mann-Kendall tests were employed. The results indicate 78,609.51 ha of degradation and 85,579.15 ha of deforestation during the study period in this region. Meanwhile, the forest restoration effort has only covered 45,525.90 ha, emphasizing the imbalance between deforestation and restoration. Deforestation is primarily driven by the expansion of agricultural lands, accounting for 79.45% of the total changes. Impervious surfaces and shrublands follow with 7.66% and 5.67%, respectively. In contrast, forest restoration has mostly occurred through the conversion of agricultural land into forests, with agricultural land contributing 74.26% to this process. Grasslands and shrublands follow with 8.14% and 7.65%, respectively. The economic analysis also revealed that deforestation has led to a loss of $1.033 billion in ecosystem service value from the Hyrcanian forests. Among the major policies, the implementation of the forest rest plan in 2016 and the inclusion of the Hyrcanian forests in the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2019 have played a significant role in mitigating forest degradation. Prior to these policies, forest degradation in some years reached approximately 4000 ha, but following their implementation, it was reduced to around 1500 ha. Additionally projections for 2030, 2040, and 2046 show that, without continued protective policies, the forest area could decrease by up to 64,340 ha by 2046, while with the continuation of policies, the forest area could increase by up to 28,554 ha. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of conservation policies and emphasize the necessity for their continuation and strengthening, along with revising land management practices, planning for ecosystem restoration, and ensuring the sustainable use of natural resources.
abstract_zh: 森林在维持环境平衡中发挥着至关重要的作用，提供了多种宝贵的生态系统服务。监测其变化动态对于规划、决策以及特别是评估保护政策日益重要。鉴于这一问题的重要性，关于全球森林变化趋势的研究数量并不均衡。希尔卡尼森林被公认为世界上最重要的温带森林之一，并自2019年起被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，是一个显著的例子。对其变化趋势的研究，尤其是在近期保护政策背景下，日益受到重视。本研究旨在利用遥感产品分析2000年至2022年间希尔卡尼森林的时空变化趋势。为评估变化的强度和方向，采用了Sen斜率和Mann-Kendall检验。结果表明，研究期间该区域发生了78，609.51公顷的退化和85，579.15公顷的毁林。与此同时，森林恢复工作仅覆盖了45，525.90公顷，凸显了毁林与恢复之间的不平衡。毁林主要由农业用地扩张驱动，占总变化的79.45%。不透水面和灌木地紧随其后，分别占7.66%和5.67%。相比之下，森林恢复主要通过农业用地向森林的转化实现，农业用地对这一过程的贡献率为74.26%。草地和灌木地紧随其后，分别占8.14%和7.65%。经济分析还揭示，毁林已导致希尔卡尼森林生态系统服务价值损失10.33亿美元。在主要政策中，2016年实施的森林休养计划和2019年希尔卡尼森林被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，在减缓森林退化方面发挥了重要作用。在这些政策实施之前，某些年份的森林退化面积约为4000公顷，而政策实施后减少至约1500公顷。此外，对2030年、2040年和2046年的预测显示，若无持续的保护政策，到2046年森林面积可能减少多达64，340公顷；而若政策得以延续，森林面积可能增加多达28，554公顷。这些发现证明了保护政策的有效性，并强调了继续和加强这些政策的必要性，同时还需修订土地管理实践、规划生态系统恢复，并确保自然资源的可持续利用。
title: Exploring land cover change patterns in Hyrcanian forests through spatiotemporal trend analysis (2000–2022)
title_zh: 基于时空趋势分析（2000–2022年）的希尔卡尼森林土地覆盖变化模式研究
